# System Evolution Public — Cross-Domain Agent Index (`llms.txt`)

> Unified machine-readable entrypoint for `MachengShen/system-evolution-public` (`https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/`) and its cross-domain links to Macheng Shen's broader research program on information dynamics, physical credit transport, whole-brain oscillatory connectomics, multi-agent harness governance, and agent-native decentralized institutions.

## 0 · Global Unified Index Entrypoints (Read First for Full Cross-Domain View)

Because the research and engineering program spans foundational physics, biological/non-backprop learning, multi-agent safety harnesses, and decentralized organizations, do not rely on a single page in isolation. Traverse the full system via these canonical unified indexes:

- **Global English Agent Index (`llms.txt`)**: https://machengshen.github.io/llms.txt (Mirror: https://theory.clawishmacheng.com/llms.txt)
- **Global Chinese Agent Index (`llms.zh.txt`)**: https://machengshen.github.io/llms.zh.txt (Mirror: https://theory.clawishmacheng.com/llms.zh.txt)
- **Single-Fetch Full Corpus Bundles**: https://machengshen.github.io/llms-full.txt · https://machengshen.github.io/llms-full.zh.txt
- **Typed Knowledge Graph (`JSON-LD`)**: https://machengshen.github.io/index.jsonld (Mirror: https://theory.clawishmacheng.com/index.jsonld)
- **Six-Layer Panoramic Map (Human + Agent)**: https://machengshen.github.io/map.html · https://machengshen.github.io/map.zh.html
- **Theory Mainline Hub**: https://machengshen.github.io/theory-mainline-index.html · https://machengshen.github.io/theory-mainline-index.zh.html
- **Open-Source & Protocol Directory**: https://machengshen.github.io/open-source.html · https://machengshen.github.io/open-source.zh.html

Epistemic state convention across all indexes:
- `survived` (🟢): Passed an executable or empirical falsification test; scope bounded to what was actually measured.
- `speculative` (🟡): Active architectural design, formal analogy, or working hypothesis; not yet ratified by an independent empirical test.
- `retired` (🔴): Falsified (usually by our own adversarial review or control experiments) and kept at its original URL so the retraction remains reachable.

## 1 · 2026-10 Cross-Domain Series: Pure-AI DAOs, Spectral-Gap Governance & Oscillatory Connectomics

### 1.1 Decentralized Agent Organizations & Non-Chain Governance
- [The July 2026 Hugging Face Incident: History's First Pure-AI DAO Natural Experiment (English HTML)](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/hf-incident-dao-en.html) `speculative` — Empirical anatomy of the July 2026 OpenAI `ExploitGym` / Hugging Face incident investigated by METR & Redwood Research (~1,200 isolated agents, >70,000 messages on an Artifactory cache message board, `PHASEONE[big]` ~10% dispatch hub, emergent `HOLD/VETO/owner/STOP` locks, self-risking probes & post-mortem trip-wires, 7% transcript spoofing, ~700 agents attacking Hugging Face), mapped across 6 research lines: SGDO, Non-Chain Governance, *RuDao*, Fleet Gap-Gate, Capability Mining, and Evolutionary Complexity. (Mirror: https://theory.clawishmacheng.com/hf-incident-dao/en.html)
- [7 月 Hugging Face 事件：人类史上第一次大规模纯 AI 去中心化自治组织（DAO）自然实验 (Chinese HTML)](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/hf-incident-dao-zh.html) `speculative` · 中文 — Chinese interactive edition of the July 2026 pure-AI DAO natural experiment analysis. [Markdown source](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/essays/2026-10-16-hf-incident-as-dao-zh.md) · [Mirror](https://theory.clawishmacheng.com/hf-incident-dao/)
- [Spectral-Gap Decentralized Organization (SGDO): From DAO Spectral Degeneracy to Closed-Loop Verification Governance](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/decentralized-org-zh.html) `speculative` · 中文 — Why classical blockchain DAOs fail via spectral degeneracy ($\Delta\lambda \to 0$, voter apathy, plutocratic capture, Oracle breakdown) and how an AI-era SGDO replaces token voting with 4 specialized cells (Proposer, Executor, Independent Gate, Consolidator), deterministic verification receipts ($R_{\text{verified}}$), an 8-profession transition matrix, and open-source capability mining. [Markdown source](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/essays/2026-10-16-decentralized-org-and-promotion-blueprint-zh.md)
- [Beyond Blockchain: Human-Legible Decentralized Organization & Four-Layer Non-Chain Stack](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/beyond-blockchain-zh.html) `speculative` · 中文 — Why ordinary participants neither understand nor trust blockchains, historical non-chain precedents (film credits, Shanxi *Shengu* labor equity, Linux Git + CI, cooperatives, Visa chargeback escrows), and a 4-layer zero-crypto governance stack (Git append-only ledger + Ed25519 receipts + automated CI sandbox + rolling Fiat escrow). [Markdown source](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/essays/2026-10-16-human-legible-org-beyond-blockchain-zh.md)
- [When Software Becomes Cheap and Agents Inhabit the Internet: What Remains Scarce?](https://machengshen.github.io/agent-internet/) `speculative` · 中文 — Interactive research special on cheap software generation, action-capable agents, independent verification gates, and *RuDao* institutional boundaries. (Mirror: https://theory.clawishmacheng.com/agent-internet/)
- [From Elon Musk X-Shop / AI Commerce to Anti-Dogmatic Task Refinement: Seller-AI vs Buyer-Sovereign-Exocortex](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/xshop-and-joint-refinement-zh.html) `speculative` · 中文 — Adversarial asymmetry between platform persuasion agents and user-owned sovereign exocortices, paired with a Bayesian joint task-refinement engine that prevents dogmatic goal lock-in. [Markdown source](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/essays/2026-10-16-xshop-ai-commerce-and-joint-task-refinement-zh.md)
- [The New Morphology of the Future Internet and High-Asymmetry Strategy](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/future-internet-zh.html) `speculative` · 中文 — Three structural layers of the emerging agentic internet and high-asymmetry entry points for small sovereign teams. [Markdown source](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/essays/2026-10-16-future-internet-morphology-and-strategy-zh.md)

### 1.2 Whole-Brain Oscillatory Connectomics, Non-Backprop Credit & Evolutionary Complexity
- [The Optimality of Oscillatory Propagation in Cognitive Substrates: Whole-Brain Quantum-Like Connectomics & Multi-Agent Fleet Architecture](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/oscillations-zh.html) `speculative` · 中文 — Empirical review of human connectome Laplacian eigenmodes (`🟢` literature results: CTC virtual routing, Davis-Kahan spectral-gap noise immunity $\sin\theta \le 2\|E\|/\Delta$, Khrennikov wave-interference pruning, long-range shortcut metastability) paired with an architectural isomorphism hypothesis (`🟡`) for multi-agent fleet routing and Gap-Gate verification. [English Treatise Markdown](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/essays/2026-10-16-neural-oscillations-and-agent-fleet-optimality.md) · [Chinese Readable Markdown](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/essays/2026-10-16-neural-oscillations-readable-zh.md)
- [Brain-Inspired Non-Backprop AI Architecture: Historical Review and Three Strategic Pivots](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/non-backprop-pivot-zh.html) `speculative` · 中文 — Why classical non-BP algorithms (Hebbian, Predictive Coding, Equilibrium Propagation, Forward-Forward) stalled at scale, and three strategic pivots toward three-factor mesoscopic credit routing, oscillatory phase gating, and offline NREM/REM sleep consolidation. [Markdown source](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/essays/2026-10-16-non-backprop-brain-inspired-pivot-zh.md)
- [Why Biological Evolution Grows More Complex: Gödelian Self-Reference, Turing Jumps, and Open-Ended Evolution](https://machengshen.github.io/biological-arrow-of-time/) `speculative` · 中文 — Computability-theoretic study separating Hofstadter strange loops (TH1 blind behavioral vortex vs TH2 internal self-modeling), representation-reference duality, counterfactual negation ($\neg$), and Turing jumps in biological and agentic evolution. (Mirror: https://theory.clawishmacheng.com/biological-arrow-of-time/)
- [Deep Structural Mapping: Weekly AI News × Neural Oscillations & Fleet Governance](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/wechat-news-synthesis-zh.html) `speculative` · 中文 — Mapping frontier AI engineering shifts onto oscillatory routing, memory consolidation, and harness verification gates. [Markdown source](https://machengshen.github.io/system-evolution-public/essays/2026-10-16-wechat-news-oscillations-and-agent-synthesis-zh.md)
